title: Method Flow flat-layout locator
failure_signature: A read-only probe assumed records and witnesses lived in nested directories although the phase stores them directly under method-flow.
trigger_preconditions: A prior phase layout is inferred without reading the current phase file list.
Several guessed paths are read in one wrapper.
candidate_workaround: List the exact current method-flow directory first and read the discovered flat filenames literally.
recurrence_guard: Discover current ledger-adjacent paths before reading method and witness records.
rollback: Retain the path errors and make no content claim from missing files.
scope_boundary: Read-only phase-local file discovery only; no repository mutation.
